They were asserted briefly and measured UNSTABLE on the first live pass -- invoice_date_extract returned null on 1 of 3 reads. The RESOLVED writeValues.invoice_date is stable across all three (the generate twin is corroborated against the printed 'Mailing Date: May 29, 2026'), and that is the value that reaches Dynamics, so it is asserted and the noisy twins beneath it are not. Note 'Mailing Date' is NOT one of find_invoice_date_in_text's accepted labels, so the printed-label fallback cannot rescue this document if BOTH twins ever fail together. || routingDecision is NOT asserted (dropped 2026-08-28, user-approved). This document is the ONLY one of the six property tax notices that prints a row labelled 'Amount due' carrying three DIFFERENT figures -- $2,428.69 / $1,858.69 / $1,583.69 for no grant / regular grant / senior grant. 'Amount due' is the strongest cue for total_invoice_amount, and the analyzer prompt has no rule for home-owner-grant columns (defect A11), so the EXTRACT twin -- which must emit a span pointing at one figure -- either anchors weakly (0.415-0.609, the lowest of all six notices) or declines outright, returning the A9 empty shape on 3 of 6 cached reads. No other notice ever loses it (0/6 each): surrey prints an 'Amount due' row too but all three columns are the SAME number, and the other four print no such row at all, anchoring instead on TOTAL TAXES PAYABLE / TOTAL TAXES DUE. Losing the extract twin removes the AGREEMENT boost, which is what actually carries every one of these six -- none reliably clears the 0.73 bar alone (property_richmond passes at extract 0.415 / generate 0.341 purely by agreement). The lone generate twin must then clear 0.73 by itself and swings 0.316-0.746, so 1 read in 6 fails B4 and routes to review. The VALUE is correct on every read and total_invoice_amount 2428.69 IS still asserted, along with the other 18 writeValues -- only the decision is not. Asserting HAPPY_PATH_CANDIDATE would assert that a document printing three candidate figures under its own 'Amount due' label always auto-writes to Dynamics with no human involved, which is not a property worth guaranteeing; B4 sending it to review is the gate working. Restore this assertion if A11 ships and the extract twin anchors reliably.
